items.sum: CRCL has plunged 36.8% in a month despite rising USDC activity and payment network growth. Can Circle overcome margin pressures and rebound sustainably?

items.t: Circle Internet Group (CRCL) Ties USDC Push In Africa To A Multi Year Deal
items.sum: Circle Internet Group (NYSE:CRCL) has entered a multi-year partnership with Global Citizen to promote USDC-based digital payments across Africa. The collaboration focuses on expanding economic opportunity in African markets through digital financial tools tied to Global Citizen events and campaigns. items.t: Singapore bank DBS partners with Circle to mint and redeem USDC
items.sum: Scott Melker discusses Circle partnering directly with DBS, Southeast Asia's largest bank, and letting eligible institutional clients mint and redeem USDC (USDC-USD) through the bank with near-instant, around-the-clock settlement. "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.

items.t: The World Bank is working with Citi & Circle on developing stablecoin infrastructure
items.sum: Scott Melker outlines what you should know about the World Bank's recent commitment with Citi (C) and Circle (CRCL) to explore the development of a regulated stablecoin system.
